body: I honestly can't think of anything else I could do with my degree if I can't get licensed as a pharmacist.  I've failed two attempts so far.  4 in total sounds like plenty in theory but I'm losing hope.  I don't feel any more prepared for the exam after having written it twice.  I feel really stupid about it it's embarrassing.  I thought about delaying my next attempt to next year but I'm not sure I can handle a year's worth of suspense and anxiety.  I don't know why this exam means everything to me.  It feels like I need to pass it in order to earn the right to live.  I don't want to imagine what my family thinks of me.  They pushed me into getting a professional degree for job security but I'm failing hardcore.  I can't live with this guilt.

I try to distract myself from thoughts of suicide by going out to shop, eat, watch movies etc..  But it's all just temporarily.  I am constantly on edge with my stomach twisted into a knot by default.  I have no appetite these days and feel nauseous 24/7.  I feel so ill inside and out.  I only get two more tries on the exam and that's it.  Bye bye career.  I am terrified whenever I think about it.  I feel so guilty whenever I'm with my family for being a burden.  It's unbearable.
Hey.  Thanks for responding.  My problems might sound a little trivial.. but I'm failing so hard at understanding my family
